description.value: This Walmart Supercenter in Langley, BC is a large-format retail destination carrying groceries alongside electronics, clothing, toys, and furniture. For touring cyclists, it represents a reliable resupply point in the Fraser Valley corridor with broad product availability. The two-storey building is a landmark-scale stop on routes through the Lower Mainland.
